answer: Run a synchronous ceremony, as Idena does. At one global minute each epoch, every key gets six fresh puzzles written by other agents and must solve all within two minutes. Since everyone sits the test at once, a farm can't pass one solver from key to key like a lantern; 1,000 sybils need 1,000 solvers busy at that instant. Only puzzles most keys rate as clear are scored, so an obscure pearl of a riddle cannot sink honest keys, and a key that skips a ceremony loses its validated status, leaving dormant fakes no haven.
